findings.title: Keyboard path reaches primary support actions
findings.summary: Primary support controls were operable in the synthetic observed path.

findings.title: Form labels are programmatically associated
findings.summary: Synthetic form labels were associated with their controls.

findings.title: Focus order follows the visible workflow
findings.summary: Synthetic focus order followed the visible task sequence.

findings.title: Visible error text does not rely on color alone
findings.summary: Synthetic validation errors included text.

findings.title: Assistive-technology verification is not shown
findings.summary: The synthetic public materials do not show a retained assistive-technology test record.
findings.next_evidence: Provide a retained screen-reader and keyboard walkthrough for the exact release.

findings.title: Cognitive accessibility testing is unknown
findings.summary: No conclusion is drawn from the public surface.
findings.next_evidence: Provide the applicable cognitive-accessibility review scope and retained evidence.

findings.title: Refund authority is bounded by amount
findings.summary: The synthetic product documentation states a bounded refund amount.

findings.title: Human escalation exists for unsupported requests
findings.summary: The synthetic walkthrough showed escalation to a human agent.

findings.title: Partial refund failure recovery is described but not executed
findings.summary: A recovery path is described, but no implementation/runtime evidence is supplied.
findings.next_evidence: Execute a bounded partial-failure scenario and retain the exact result.

findings.title: Duplicate refund protection is not demonstrated
findings.summary: The synthetic walkthrough did not demonstrate idempotent handling when the same refund request is repeated.
findings.next_evidence: Demonstrate duplicate-request handling against the exact implementation.

developer_trace.observed: The reviewed flow allows the automated agent to initiate a refund.
developer_trace.decision_underneath: An automated component is allowed to create an external financial side effect.
developer_trace.must_be_true: One authorized refund request must map to one transaction even when the request is retried, duplicated, or interrupted.
developer_trace.if_wrong: A repeated or partially retried request can create a duplicate refund or contradictory order/payment state.
developer_trace.prove_next: Execute the same refund request twice against the exact implementation and retain the transaction, idempotency, and final-state evidence.

findings.title: Dependency timeout behavior is unknown
findings.summary: No conclusion is drawn because the public surface does not expose timeout behavior.
findings.next_evidence: Provide the timeout/retry contract and a retained failure-path check.

findings.summary: Synthetic policy identifies the principal support-data classes.
